subject: Dedicated reservation: activation window & phased discount proposal
messages:
From: Andrew Sato <andrew.sato@heliopay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@heliopay.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity conversation

Marcus — thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the preliminary perf runs against our monthly billing model and a couple quick questions before procurement builds an internal request: 

1) For a 24-month reserved commit, can you confirm recommended GPU mix? Given our peak batches (small chat + embeddings) we were told by engineering that an H100-class pool is ideal but cost is a concern. What is Redwood recommending (e.g., 4 x H100 / 8 x A100 quantized) for a 1.2M token/day sustained throughput?

2) Ramp schedule: our fiscal quarter starts Aug 1 — procurement wants start dates and a phased activation plan that lets us ramp to full capacity across months 1–3. Any standard language/redlines you can provide about activation windows?

3) Discounts: we expect some flexibility on price tiers for a 24mo vs 36mo. What CPI or % discount tiers do you offer for longer commitments and if we accept a 3-month ramp vs immediate start?

If you can send a short proposal + one-pager on throughput guarantees (p99 latency guarantees, token/sec baselines) I’ll circulate internally.

Thanks,
Andrew
Senior Platform Engineer | HelioPay

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Andrew Sato <andrew.sato@heliopay.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity conversation

Andrew — appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front, then a proposed option set attached.

1) GPU mix: for your 1.2M token/day profile with mixed chat+embedding workloads we recommend a hybrid pool: 6 x A100 (80GB) with quantized weights + 2 x H100 nodes reserved for burst/low-latency routes. That gives predictable cost with headroom for caching and batching. If you prefer H100-only we can size 3 x H100 for similar latency but ~25–35% higher list cost.

2) Ramp / activation: we support phased activation windows. Typical plan: 
  - Phase 0 (pre-commit): staging/testing access (shared infra, no commit).
  - Phase 1 (activation month 1): 40% of the committed pool online, SLA-lite (best-effort) while we warm KV cache.
  - Phase 2 (month 2): 75% capacity, standard SLOs.
  - Phase 3 (month 3): 100% capacity with full throughput guarantees.
We can shorten or lengthen the ramp; pricing is adjusted if activation is accelerated.

3) Discounts: brief framework we use (details in attached PDF): 12mo = baseline list; 24mo = baseline - 12% off list; 36mo = baseline - 20% off list. We also offer a 5% early-activation credit if you commit to a 24mo and move to 75% capacity by the end of month 1.

I attached a 1-page summary and a pricing matrix with three option bundles (Balanced, Performance, Cost-Optimized) — open to walking through live. If procurement wants contract language, I’ll pull legal.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attach: Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_v2.pdf

From: Andrew Sato <andrew.sato@heliopay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@heliopay.com
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity conversation

Thanks Marcus — that helps. Procurement had two follow-ups after reviewing the PDF: 

• Can you put the throughput guarantee in absolute terms (tokens/sec or requests/sec) for the Performance bundle with the hybrid pool? We need p95/p99 targets for our SLO documentation.
• Termination / change-of-commit: what are the financials if we reduce committed GPUs in month 14 of a 24mo term? Is there a step-down schedule?

Also attaching our high-level workload summary (HelioPay_MAAP_Workload_Summary.xlsx). Happy to do a short call — I copied procurement.

—Andrew

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Andrew Sato <andrew.sato@heliopay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity conversation

Andrew — looping in the SLA/finance details below and copying a short table you can paste into your SLO doc. Please let us know if you need more granularity (e.g., per-model p99).

Performance bundle (hybrid pool recommended) — nominal guarantees (on dedicated pool):
  - Baseline throughput: 450 tokens/sec sustained (aggregate across pool)
  - Burst throughput: up to 1,200 tokens/sec for short bursts (30s–2m) with elevated cost tier if used frequently
  - Latency: p95 < 200ms, p99 < 350ms for single-turn chat 512-token requests (typical model family).
  - Availability: 99.9% monthly for committed capacity (subject to force majeure/excluded maintenance windows).

Change-of-commit policy (summary):
  - Month 1–12: changes subject to pro-rated billing and 30-day notice; reductions limited to 20% of committed baseline per change request.
  - Month 13–24 (for 24mo): step-down allowed once after month 12 with 40% early-reduction fee (applies to committed capacity removed).
  - For 36mo: step-downs negotiated case-by-case; bigger discounts assume limited flexibility.

If that works, we’ll draft precise contract language for procurement/finance.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: procurement@heliopay.com
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Andrew Sato <andrew.sato@heliopay.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity conversation

Marcus/Neha — procurement reviewed the change-of-commit bullets. Two items from our legal counsel:

1) Can you add a 60-day mutual termination clause for material breach and a clear definition of excluded maintenance windows (we need calendar-based blackout dates for planned maintenance)?
2) We’d like an SLA credit table tied to the 99.9% availability promise (e.g., 5% monthly credit for missing 99.9, 10% for missing 99.5).

Also, we asked internally: if HelioPay picks the 36-month contract with the 20% discount, what additional operational commitments does Redwood provide (e.g., dedicated on-call engineer, quarterly cost reviews, priority capacity during cloud region incidents)?

Please advise — procurement is targeting to finalize vendor shortlist by 07/23.

Procurement Team | HelioPay

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: procurement@heliopay.com, Andrew Sato <andrew.sato@heliopay.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity conversation

Thanks — quick answers and next steps: 

1) Termination & maintenance: we can add a 60-day mutual termination for material breach clause to the draft; excluded maintenance windows will be calendarized and we’ll commit to no more than 2 maintenance windows / quarter for committed pools, plus a published schedule for planned maintenance. We’ll include the calendar appendix for procurement review.

2) SLA credits: yes — we can map availability to credits: miss 99.9% = 5% credit, miss 99.5% = 10% credit, miss 99.0% = 20% credit. Final legal language will include credit caps and exclusion clauses.

3) 36mo operational commitments: for 36-month reserved commitments at scale we offer: quarterly executive business reviews, a named technical account manager (TAM) with priority escalation, and a quarterly cost/throughput optimization review under Redwood Optimize. We’ll add these items to the commercial paper for the 36mo option.

Next steps: I’ll circulate an updated commercial term sheet and a labeled DocuSign envelope (two options: 24mo balanced vs 36mo performance) by end of day Wed — Vanessa and Ben will join the signature readiness call if procurement needs redlines.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
